name: meeting-time-spread
title: Meeting Time Spread
description: Meeting time slider with each attendee's day underneath (night, before or after work, weekend, day ahead or behind, DST weeks via the tz database) that suggests the kindest slot: nobody at night, then fewest out of hours, then rotating away from recent sufferers.

meta.stops: Same colleague always gets 3 AM calls
mistakes: meeting at night for remote colleague
meta.summary: Shows every attendee's local day under a meeting-time slider and suggests the kindest slot, so the same person doesn't always take the 3 AM call.
catches: Slots in someone's night or outside their working hours
Weekend or a different calendar day for some attendees
DST weeks when the time gap shifts
The same person repeatedly taking bad slots (from history)
limits: Working hours default to 9–17.5 local and weekends to Sat/Sun; pass real ones
History-based fairness only knows the past meetings you pass
Plans one day at a time
a11y: Slider has a visible label and aria-valuetext describing who is at night
Status uses role=status; icons are aria-hidden
Focus returns to the slider after applying a suggestion
Animations are reduced under reduced motion
